section_summary.extract_value: This discussion section summarizes the findings of the research, noting that sexual minority women reported higher mean body size and body appreciation, though the effect size was small. It explores objectification theory in relation to body image differences by sexual orientation and finds no significant difference in body appreciation between bisexual and other sexual minority women. The study acknowledges limitations, including a sample primarily of educated White women and the use of two cross-sectional samples collected at different times.
